In addition, officials from the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, representatives from the WHO Secretariat and United Nations Agencies, development partners and representatives from non-governmental organizations will also participate in this. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to host the 78th  Session of the WHO Regional Committee Meeting for South-East Asia, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 'Healthy Food - Happy Life - සුවදායී දිවියකට සෞඛ්‍යවත්/සුරක්ෂිත ආහාර' -The National Media Drive
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Government has prioritized its direct intervention concerning food-related diseases and the lack of compliance with regard to the legal  safety guidelines associated thereto in the present day society. Accordingly, the Ministry of Health and Mass Media and Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation intends to implement the National Media Drive, 'Healthy Food - Happy Life - සුවදායී දිවියකට සෞඛ්‍යවත්/සුරක්ෂිත ආහාර' in order to launch a health promotion programme on the nutrition of Sri Lankans. This programme has been planned to implement in liaison with women, school children, public and private sector institutions associated with food safety, doctors, nutritionists, public health inspectors, farmers and cooks/chefs. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to implement the said National Media Drive by the Sri Lanka Rupavahini Corporation under the supervision of the Ministry of Health and Mass Media, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-commencement of the projects related to the scope of  urban development that were temporarily suspended
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The construction activities of 18 projects that were commenced in 2021 and thereafter have been temporarily suspended, slowed down or suspended by mutual consent due to problems arising amidst the economic crisis. Out of the 18 projects that were suspended, 06 projects have now been completed. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to re-commence and implement the following projects that were not completed, was approved by the Cabinet: * Construction of the proposed Walapane sathi pola and the multipurpose building. * Development of the Daulagala sathi pola and the vehicle park. * Development of the Mullaitivu bus stand. * Improving sanitary facilities and landscapes in Habarana. * Development of the pathway from Ruwanweliseya vehicle park to the Jetavanaramaya. * Construction of the administrative building of Polonnaruwa new town. * Construction of the Ampara sathi pola. * Development of the Deiyandara bus stand. * Development of the Gampaha public market. * Development of the Peralanda wetland park. * Development of the Panadura public market and the multipurpose building.

description: Current status and strategic pathway in introducing the Hydrogen Economy in Sri Lanka
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Sri Lanka is seeking sustainable solutions to reduce carbon emissions and diversify its energy mix, and green hydrogen has been identified as a viable alternative energy source which is aligned with national and global climate goals. Accordingly, the Ministry of Energy has taken several important initial steps by now, including the launch of the National Hydrogen Roadmap and drafting of a comprehensive Renewable Hydrogen Policy. The Ministry of Energy intends to conduct Public Consultation Workshops and Key Stakeholder Workshops relating to this to improve the policy framework, overcome potential problems and build a broad consensus for successful implementation of the same. Accordingly, the Cabinet took into notice of the submissions made by the Minister of Energy regarding the steps being taken to develop the Hydrogen sector in Sri Lanka in accordance with local conditions and needs and in line with international safety standards and performance benchmarks.

description: Declaration of the Sabarimala Pilgrimage as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sr Lanka and provision of facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - For a long time, Sri Lankan Hindu devotees have been taking part in pilgrimages to the famous Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala, India, every year from 1st  November to 31st  January of the following year. This has now become a spiritual pilgrimage attended by over 15,000 Sri Lankan devotees annually. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to declare the pilgrimage by Sri Lankan Hindu devotees to the Sabarimala Ayyappan Kovil in Kerala of India as a sacred pilgrimage recognized by the Government of Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme of Sri Lanka Tea Board for 'Ceylon Tea' Exporters
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Sri Lanka Tea Board has been implementing the 50% Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme for Sri Lankan Tea Exporters since 2015 to facilitate Sri Lankan tea exporters to find new international buyers and promote their 'Ceylon Tea' brands globally. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantations and Community Infrastructure to continue the said Trade Fair Subsidy Scheme, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creating a Digital Rubber Land Mapping/Registration System
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The European Union has introduced new regulations (EUDR) that must be complied with when exporting rubber and rubber-related products to the countries of the European Union which is a major market for Sri Lankan rubber. Sri Lanka will also have to comply with the new regulations after 2025‑12‑31 to ensure that rubber supply chains do not contribute to deforestation. Accordingly, the need to create a Digital Rubber Land Mapping System has been identified to ensure that rubber supply chains do not contribute to deforestation. This project will geo-coordinate the rubber lands of small rubber plantation owners across the country and create a comprehensive and verifiable database on land ownership and use using innovative Geographic Information System (GIS) technology. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Plantation and Community Infrastructure to implement the project to create a Digital Rubber Land Mapping/Registration System, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Providing underutilized lands/properties under the State institutions  to Suitable Investors for optimal utilization
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed through the Budget 2025 to identify underutilized lands under the institutions such as the Land Reform Commission, Regional Plantation Companies, National Livestock Development Board, Sri Lanka State Plantations Corporation, and Janatha Estate Development Board, and provide the said lands for private investments including small and medium scale enterprises so that they could be utilized for economically productive projects.  Under this programme, investment opportunities are expected to be provided for plantation/agricultural activities, plantation-related tourism promotion activities, livestock development, hydroelectric power generation, solar power generation, factory-related production activities, inland fisheries industry, and other plantation-related economic innovations. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land & Irrigation for calling Expressions of Interest to select suitable investors for the identified lands, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of Diplomatic Relations with Belize
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval of the Cabinet has been granted previously to establish diplomatic relations with Latin American countries of Guatemala, Suriname, Belize, Honduras, Nicaragua, Antigua & Barbuda, Barbados, Dominica, Grenada, Haiti, St. Kits & Nevis, St. Lucia and St. Vincent and the Grenadines. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the Joint Communique on the Establishment of Diplomatic Relations between the Government of Sri lanka and the Government of Belize in order to enhance the friendly relations and cooperation in the political, socio-economic and cultural fields for mutual benefits of the two countries, was approved by the cabinet.

description: Implementation of the “District Development Programme - 2025”
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-11 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Provisions of Rs.2,000 million have been allocated through the Budget 2025 to implement the District Development Programme as a national level development programme covering all Districts in Sri Lanka. Under the said programme, it is expected to achieve the following objectives;  *  Infrastructure improvement  *  Promotion of domestic production capabilities  *  Enhancing service delivery mechanisms  *  improving trade and marketing facilities  *  Strengthening institutional capacityThe proposal made by the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Fiance, Planning and Economic Development to allocate provisions provided through the Budget Estimate 2025 to each District for the implementation of the District Development Programme - 2025, based on the District Poverty Level of Sri Lanka published by the Department of Census and Statistics using the Multidimensional Poverty Index which is a global measure used to identify poverty, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 10,000 Vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vials
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 10,000 vials of Tenecteplase Injection 40mg Vial used for people with heart diseases. Three (03) bids have been submitted for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement for a sum of USD 3.7 million to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Boehringer Ingelheim India Pvt. Ltd., India (Manufacturer: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co‑KG, Germany), based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of a Presidential Task Force for the implementation of the Sri Lanka Tourism Development Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A primary attention of the Government has been focused on taking necessary measures for the development of the tourism industry in creating a prosperous country under "A Modernized Tourist Industry - An Attractive Destination", in accordance with the current Government policy statement. The need to establish a Presidential Task Force has been identified, enabling to carry out these tasks more effectively and efficiently. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon. President to establish a Presidential Task Force under the Chairmanship of the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism, with the representations of the relevant ministries, institutions and various sectors of the tourism field in order to achieve the rapid development goals and attain a high level substantial growth in the tourism industry, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment to the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1998
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been about 25 years since the National Child Protection Authority Act, No. 50 of 1998 was passed. Due to the social, economic, political and cultural transformations that have taken place during this period, child abuse and violence against children have become complex in nature. Therefore, the necessity of amending the existing laws in a manner that suits the current needs to prevent and respond to all forms of abuse against children has been identified. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the National Child Protection Authority Act, No.50 of 1998, incorporating the amendments identified in order to perform the functions of the said Act in a more broad, meaningful and efficient manner, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Implementation of the Projects on Development of Sports Infrastructure Facilities
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Developing human resources and sports infrastructure facilities in the field of sports to popularize sports is a main role of the Department of Sports Development. The Department of Sports Development has planned to implement three projects for the school system, public play grounds and youth clubs within a period of 03 years from the year 2025 with the aim of developing sports infrastructure facilities for the youth and elderly community, sports clubs and schools that do not have adequate sports facilities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to implement the Projects of Creating a sports culture, Providing sports infrastructure facilities for schools in rural areas and youth clubs and Development of infrastructure facilities in identified sports schools, by the Department of Sports Development during the period of 2025-2027, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 50 Polyaxial MRI compatible (Titanium/Cobolt-Chrome) Lumber pedicle screws and 20 instrument set for posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumber fusion (for scoliosis correction)
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the purchase of 50 polyaxial MRI compatible lumbar pedicle screws used for spinal surgeries and 20 instrument sets for posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumbar fusion. Six bids and five bids have been received respectively for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the procurement of 50 Lumbar pedicle screws to Avenierr Pharma (Pvt) Ltd. and the procurement of 20 instrument sets of posterior thoracic Thoraco-lumbar fusion equipment to A. Baur & Co. (Pvt) Ltd., based on the recommendations of the Technical Evaluation Committee and the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 450,000 prefilled Syringes/Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 6,000IU in 0.6ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 450,000 prefilled Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 6,000IU, 0.6ml Syringes/Vials used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., India (Manufacturer - M/s. Emcure Pharmaceuticals Ltd., India) for a sum of USD 751,500, based on the recommendation of the Standing High-Level Procurement Committee on the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Procurement for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Syringes/Vials of Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU in 0.4ml
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - International Competitive Bids have been invited for the supply of 900,000 prefilled Enoxaparin Sodium Injection 4,000IU, 0.4ml Syringes/Vials used for the treatment of patients with heart diseases. Six (06) bids have been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Health and Mass Media to award the relevant procurement to the lowest evaluated substantially responsive bidder, M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India (Manufacturer - M/s. Gland Pharma Limited, India) for a sum of USD 1.143 million, based on the recommendation of the Standing High‑Level Procurement Committee on the relevant bids, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Re-implementation of the housing projects of the Colombage Mawatha and Torrington Avenue under the Urban Regeneration Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2024‑12‑30 to resume the initial works of the two housing projects in the Colombage Mawatha and Torrington Avenue which were implemented under the Urban Regeneration Project and had halted halfway. The Colombage Mawatha project consists of 615 housing units whereas the Torrington Avenue housing project consists of 115 housing units. The estimated cost for the implementation of the said projects is Rs.7.48 billion, and it is expected that it will take about 2 ½ years to complete the construction work. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to have the provisions required for the implementation of the said projects allocated from the year 2026 to the year 2028, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Purchasing a Dredger for the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A cost-benefit analysis has been conducted regarding the purchase of a dredger for the essential maintenance and development activities of the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation. The said Corporation requires to dredge about 183,000 cubic meters of sand annually, and since a cost of about Rs.500 million has to be incurred in obtaining the dredging service for that purpose from the private sector, purchasing a dredger for the Corporation itself has proven to be economically beneficial in the long term. Further, it is possible to use the dredger so purchased for dredging activities to be carried out in lagoons such as Arugam Bay, Nandikadal, Nayaru, Lankapatuna under the Lagoon Conservation and Management Programme implemented under the Ministry of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Fisheries, Aquatic and Ocean Resources to purchase a dredger for the Ceylon Fishery Harbours Corporation, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Development of the Pettah Central Bus Stand under the 'Clean Sri Lanka' Programme
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Due to lack of repairs and modernizations over decades, the access roads, bus yards, passenger waiting areas, rest rooms for drivers and conductors, administrative buildings, sanitation and drainage systems of the Pettah Central Bus Stand are currently in a very dilapidated state. As a consequence, passengers using the Pettah Central Bus Stand, as well as drivers and conductors and the staff engaged in operational activities, face severe inconveniences. Therefore, the renovation and development of the Pettah Central Bus Stand to suit the present day has been identified as an urgent and timely need. It is estimated that approximately Rs.425 million will be incurred for the relevant modernization and development works. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, Ports and Civil Aviation to modernize and develop the Pettah Central Bus Stand, using the provisions allocated for the 'Clean Sri Lanka' programme, with the direct labor contribution of the Sri Lanka Air Force and with the contribution and cooperation of other relevant institutions including the Colombo Municipal Council, the Ceylon Electricity Board, the National Water Supply and Drainage Board, the Road Development Authority and the Urban Development Authority, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Signing of a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology (Pvt) Ltd. and the University of Illinois of the United States of America
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been proposed to enter into a Memorandum of Understanding between Sri Lanka Institute of Biotechnology (Pvt) Ltd. and the University of Illinois of the United States of America facilitating activities and programmes such as human resource skills development in genetic research and exchange of postgraduate students and staff. The concurrence of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism has been received for the proposed draft Memorandum of Understanding. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Science and Technology to sign the said MoU between the two parties, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Revising the coverage limit of Group Insurance policy for the Hon. Members of Parliament
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2023‑05-15 for the implementation of a group insurance policy for the Hon. Members of Parliament, subject to a maximum insurance coverage of Rs. 1 million per parliamentary year. Accordingly, relevant insurance coverages have been provided during the past period. At the time of presenting the Budget 2025, the Hon. President proposed to reduce the insurance coverage limit of Rs.1,000,000/- for a Member of Parliament to Rs.250,000/-. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Public Security and Parliamentary Affairs to provide a group insurance policy for the Members of Parliament by limiting the insurance benefits for a Member of Parliament to Rs.250,000/- from the insurance year scheduled to commence on 2025‑10‑09 onwards, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Establishment of an Inter-Ministerial Standing Committee under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women (CEDAW) was established in 1982 as a result of the declaration of a Charter on the Rights of Women by the United Nations General Assembly and adoption of the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women in 1979. Sri Lanka has ratified the said Convention and is responsible for following constitutional procedures, enacting legislation and providing periodic reports as required. Based on the recommendations made by the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women in relation to Sri Lanka under the Convention on the Elimination of All Forms of Discrimination against Women, the Ministry in charge of the subject of Women's Affairs, in collaboration with the Ministry in charge of the subject of Foreign Affairs and other relevant ministries/institutions, prepares a periodic report once in every 04 years. Accordingly, the Ninth (09) Periodic Report prepared by Sri Lanka has been submitted to the 90th Session of the United Nations Committee on the Elimination of Discrimination against Women held in Geneva, Switzerland from 3rd to 21st February 2025. It has been identified the necessity of having an integrated approach regarding mandatory reporting and follow-up obligations, at a review held under the Chairmanship of the Hon. Prime Minister and with the participation of other parties, regarding the concluding observations on the Periodic Report made during that Session.  Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Women and Child Affairs to establish an Inter-Ministerial Standing Committee, enabling to pursue action accordingly and to enter into relevant policy decisions, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Formulating a National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per the provisions of the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation Act, No.1 of 2024, the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation has been vested with power to formulate and implement a National Policy on Reconciliation and Coexistence and a National Action Plan. Accordingly, the Roadmap for Formulating National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence has been prepared by the Office for National Unity and Reconciliation.  The proposed National Policy and Action Plan seeks to achieve shared national aspirations such as strengthening institutional mechanisms, restoring public confidence, promoting inter-ethnic and inter-religious dialogue, and empowering youth and women as agents of peace. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to prepare a National Policy and Action Plan on Reconciliation and Coexistence for the period from 2025 - 2029 through a multi-stake holder approach, to establish an Inter-Ministerial Task Force comprising representatives of relevant Ministries and Line Agencies, and to obtain the necessary technical, logistical, financial and administrative support from the United Nations in Sri Lanka, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment of a new Delimitation Committee to review the recommendations of the Delimitation Committee held in the years 2012 and 2021 and submit recommendations
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - A Delimitation Committee has been appointed in the year 2012 to establish and revise Divisional Secretariat Divisions and Grama Niladhari Divisions, and measures have been taken to implement only some of the recommendations of the said Committee. Subsequently, a Delimitation Committee has been appointed again in the year 2021, and no actions have been taken so far regarding the recommendations of the said Committee.  The proposal made by the Minister of Public Administration, Provincial Councils and Local Government to submit the recommendations of the said Committee Report to the relevant Regional Coordination Committees and District Coordination Committees and obtain their recommendations, and to appoint a new Delimitation Committee to review the said recommendations and submit a Report with recommendations, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Calling for Investments Proposals for the land called Chalmer's Granary located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort owned by the Urban Development Authority
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The land of Chalmers Granary in extent of 09 acres 02 roods 31.75 perches (3.9248 hectares) located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort, owned by the Urban Development Authority, is located within the Compact Mixed Development Zone of the Development Plan prepared for the Colombo Municipal Council area for the period 2022-2031. It has been found appropriate to dispose the said land on a lease basis for the implementation of a mixed development project with higher financial, environmental and social potential, from among the permissible uses within the Compact Mixed Development Zone, including residential, healthcare, offices and corporate, commercial, educational, customer service centers, tourism, recreational and other activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to invite Investment Proposals from interested investors, to dispose the relevant land on a 99-year lease basis based on the updated valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Creation of the Virtual City in Kandy under the Virtual City Creation Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The city of Kandy, which houses the historic Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, has been identified to create in the name of Virtual City in Kandy as a pilot project of the Virtual City Creation Project. It has been planned to technically create 58 locations identified as priority sites with tourist attractions and tourist potential which are centered around the city of Kandy as the first part of the said pilot project and 20 locations of historical and tourism significance associated with the historical Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and its surroundings as the second phase of the project. The Ministry of Digital Economy has recommended Sri Lanka Telecom PLC as the suitable entity for the relevant work after evaluating the feasibility and technical capabilities of the production company and the previous production work carried out by the said Company. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to carry out the production activities of the Virtual City in Kandy Project by Sri Lanka Telecom PLC using the provisions allocated under the Clean Sri Lanka Project, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Granting 'Approved Enterprise' status to import Companies to re-export selected Spices
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet, at its meeting held on 2023‑12‑18, has granted approval for the procedure for the importation and processing of selected spices for re-export purpose in the form of oil extracts, oleoresins and spent. Accordingly, the Import and Export (Control) Regulations No. 10 of 2024 have been imposed for the said purpose. Several enterprises have already signed Supplementary Agreements with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka for importing and processing selected spices as per the said Regulations. The Board of Investment of Sri Lanka has recommended to grant the 'Approved Enterprise' status to such enterprises. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Hon, President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, to grant the 'Approved Enterprise' status to the following enterprises that have fulfilled the requirements of the procedure approved for re-export in the form of oil extracts, oleoresins and spent, was approved by the Cabinet. * Stay Naturals (Pvt) Ltd. * Verger Naturals (Pvt) Ltd. * Plant Lipids Lanka (Pvt) Ltd. * HDDES Extracts (Pvt) Ltd.

description: Statement on Financial Performance of the Government for the Second Quarter 2025s
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-08-04 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - As per section 53(1) of the Public Financial Management Act No.44 of 2024, the Minister in charge of the subject of Finance should submit a statement on financial performance including revenue and expenditure of the Government to the Cabinet at least on quarterly basis within a period of not less than 45 days after completion of each quarter. Accordingly, the Hon. President in his capacity as the Minister of Finance, Planning and Economic Development, having submitted the Report on Financial Performance prepared including cumulative revenue and expenditure reported by all Special Spending Units, Ministries, Departments, and District Secretariats for the second quarter ended on 2025‑06‑30, based on the classifications stated in Annual Budget Estimate for the year 2025, and the Cabinet Noted the said Report.

description: Signing a Memorandum of Understanding under the Seasonal Worker Programme for Agriculture and Fisheries in the Republic of Korea
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Approval has been granted at the Cabinet meetings held on 2025-02-19 and    2025‑07‑01, to implement a pilot project to facilitate the deployment of Sri Lankan workers under the E-8 visa category (seasonal workers) in the Republic of Korea and to hold discussions with the Korean counties who are interested for the same. Accordingly, as a result of the discussions held with the Boseong county of Korea, it has been agreed to recruit seasonal workers from Sri Lanka and enter into a Memorandum of Understanding for the same. The proposed Memorandum of Understanding will provide opportunity for Sri Lankans to work in agricultural villages in the Boseong County for a short period of time (up to a maximum of 8 months) under the Seasonal Worker Programme to earn an income and earn foreign exchange for the country. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Foreign Employment and Tourism to sign the proposed Memorandum of Understanding with the Boseong County, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Appointment to the Post of Conservator General of Forests
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Mr. E.A.P.N. Edirisinghe, who served as the Conservator General of Forests, has retired from the Public Service from 2025-07-08, on completion of the age of 60 years. Accordingly, taking into consideration the proposal made by the Minister of Environment, the Cabinet decided to appoint Mr. W.W.M.P.S.C. Palamakumbura, Special Grade Officer of the Sri Lanka Scientific Service, presently serving as the Additional Conservator General of Forests (Forest Protection, Operations and Management) in the Department of Forest Conservation, to the vacant post of Conservator General of Forests, with immediate effect.

description: Parliamentary submission of Regulations made under section 41, to be read with section 31 of the Sports Law, No.25 of 1973
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - It has been observed that various ambiguities have arisen due to the frequent amendment of the Sports Regulations issued in terms of the powers vested with the Minister in-charge of Sports by the provisions of the Sports Law, No. 25 of 1973 and that the independence and impartiality that should prevail in sports are undermined by the politicization of sports. Therefore, with the objective of preventing fraud and corruption in sports and carrying forward sports in an independent and impartial manner, the National Sports Associations Regulations No.01 of 2025 have been made and published in the Gazette Extraordinary Notification No.2437/24 dated 2025-05-21 regarding the administration, functions, powers, duties and general provisions of the National Sports Associations. The proposal made by the Minister of Youth Affairs and Sports to submit the said Regulations to Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Amendment of the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Antiquities Ordinance, No. 9 of 1940 has been enacted for the conservation of antiquities of Sri Lanka and the sites and buildings with historical or archaeological importance in Sri Lanka. The said Ordinance was last amended in the year 1998 and the Department of Archaeology is currently facing a number of challenges in the protection of antiquities. Therefore, the need has arisen to amend the relevant Ordinance by incorporating new Laws to suit the current needs and to take prompt action, especially to prevent the destruction of antiquities, theft of antiquities, unauthorized excavations and export of antiquities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Buddhasasana, Religious and Cultural Affairs to instruct the Legal Draftsman to prepare a Bill to amend the Antiquities Ordinance No.9 of 1940, incorporating the amendments identified through conducting workshops and discussions with scholars in the relevant field, archaeologists, archaeological officers and social activists, was approved by the Cabinet.

description: Presenting the Presidents' Entitlements (Repeal) Bill in Parliament for approval
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-07-21 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Cabinet has granted approval on 2025-06-16 to prepare a Bill to repeal the Presidents' Entitlements Act, No.4 of 1986, enabling to abolish the special privileges granted to former Presidents and their families, as stated in the Government manifesto 'A thriving nation - A beautiful Life'. Accordingly, the Presidents' Entitlements (Repeal) Bill has been prepared by the Legal Draftsman for that purpose and the clearance of the Attorney General has been received for the same. The proposal made by the Minister of Justice and National Integration to publish the said Bill in the Government Gazette and thereafter to present the same in Parliament for approval, was approved by the Cabinet.
